pressure.name: Closing pressure
pressure.desc: Closing above the day's average price (VWAP). On NEPSE this predicts LOWER returns: late-day pushes tend to unwind.

calm.name: Low volatility
calm.desc: Calm, steady stocks (60-day volatility). Works in normal and falling markets; fails in euphoric bull runs.

nolottery.name: No lottery spikes
nolottery.desc: Stocks WITHOUT a recent huge one-day jump. Spiky 'lottery' stocks tend to disappoint later.

bounce.name: Short-term bounce
bounce.desc: Stocks that fell more than their sector over the last 5 days tend to recover a little.

high52.name: Near 52-week high
high52.desc: Stocks close to their 1-year high tend to keep doing slightly better.

chasing.name: Circuit chasing
chasing.desc: How often the stock hit the +10% upper circuit in the last 20 days. Frequent circuit-hitters tend to fall back later.

momentum.name: 3-month momentum
momentum.desc: The global classic. No reliable edge on NEPSE, so it starts at zero weight; the bot will use it only if it starts working.

size.name: Company size
size.desc: Bigger, more-traded companies vs smaller ones. Direction flips by year, so it starts at zero.
